lines.text: David says he takes refuge in the LORD, though he is told to flee like a bird to your mountain.
The wicked bend their bows to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.
The LORD is on Mount Sinai, and His eyes examine the sons of men.
The LORD tests the righteous and the wicked, and He will rain down hail and great stones on the wicked.
The LORD is righteous and loves justice, and the upright will see His face.
